Dapardalana
didactic, satirical poem in 7 chs. on human pride arising from birth, wealth etc. by Kṣemendra.
Bd. 402. 403. BORI. 402 an. 403 of 1887-91. BORI. D. XIII. i. 286. 287. Bühler 540. H. 63. IO. 3928. 7087. Oxf. II. 1237. PUL. II. p. 256 (inc.). Radh. 21 (a..). RASB. VII. 5498.
